headline: Mezo Earn: 4 Mezo-chain pool contracts confirmed via docs; 10+ Earn-specific contracts (VotingEscrow, Voter, Gauges, Splitters, MUSD Savings Vault) identified in audit scope but deployed addresses not published in official docs or discoverable via supported-chain explorers. Mezo chain (chainId 31611) is outside DeFiPunkd supported chainId list.
short_headline: Pool addresses found; Earn contracts undiscovered

findings.text: D1: Mezo chain (explorer.mezo.org, chainId 31611) is not among DeFiPunkd-supported chainIds and no direct block-explorer fetch was performed this run. The docs contracts page lists 4 Mezo-chain pool contracts (PoolFactory, MUSD/BTC Pool, MUSD/mUSDC Pool, MUSD/mUSDT Pool) and numerous bridged token addresses. No Mezo Earn-specific contract addresses (VotingEscrow, Voter, Gauges, Splitters) were surfaced from the docs contracts page. Ethereum pre-mainnet contracts (multisig 0x98D8899c3030741925BE630C710A98B57F397C7a, timelock 0x82f08041f1Bc1aa399320743F33f75CcA482b25a, Portal ProxyAdmin 0x260cA2abeF5d38181E2562F00FA92AD1DC681734) listed as pre-mainnet only.

D2: Official deployments doc fetched at https://mezo.org/docs/users/resources/contracts-reference/ — lists Pool contracts (PoolFactory, 3 named pools), bridged token addresses, MUSD/MEZO NTT bridge addresses across Mezo/Ethereum/Base/BSC/Solana, and Portal contract addresses on Ethereum. Mezo Earn core contracts (VotingEscrow, Voter, Gauge factories, Splitters, MUSD Savings Rate vault) are absent from this page. No deployed_contracts_doc for Earn-specific addresses was found.

D3: Halborn Mezo Earn audit (2026-01-08) fetched — repository tigris-token-launch, assessed commit 2ed567e. 26 contracts in scope: BoostVoter, MEZOChainSplitter, MEZOEcosystemSplitter, MEZOMinter, NonStakingVoter, Splitter, ThirdPartyVoter, ValidatorsVoter, Voter, VotingEscrow, ve/Balance, ve/Delegation, ve/Escrow, ve/Grant, ve/ManagedNFT, ve/NFT, ve/VeERC2771Context, ve/VotingEscrowState, vaults/IdleStrategy, vaults/MUSDSavingsRate, gauges/Gauge, gauges/NoFeesGauge, gauges/NonStakingGauge, gauges/PoolGauge, gauges/StakingGauge, gauges/VaultGauge. No deployed mainnet addresses listed in audit scope section. Thesis Defense Mezo Earn audit (2026-01-30) also listed in audits page but PDF not fetched this run. All 16 findings addressed (100%) per Halborn summary.

D4: GitHub org is https://github.com/mezo-org. Audit confirms repository name tigris-token-launch. No direct GitHub fetch was performed this run (no repo URL was pre-pinned). The audit commit SHA 2ed567e was extracted from the Halborn PDF. No Foundry broadcast or hardhat deployment JSON files were fetched.

D5: Protocol.chains lists only 'Mezo'. Mezo chain uses chainId 31611 per community blog post. The contracts-reference page lists some addresses also deployed on Ethereum, Base, BSC (MUSD and MEZO bridge components), but Mezo Earn contracts themselves are only on the Mezo chain. No other chains need enumeration for Earn-specific contracts.

D6: PoolFactory (0x83FE469C636C4081b87bA5b3Ae9991c6Ed104248 on Mezo) identified from docs. No read-API fetch performed as Mezo chainId (31611) is not supported by DeFiPunkd API. Gauge factory/voter contracts exist per audit scope but no factory address was published in docs. Cap notice: cannot enumerate gauge children without on-chain read.

D7: Role taxonomy applied to all discovered addresses. PoolFactory classified as factory/unknown. Pool contracts classified as pool/unknown. Pre-mainnet Ethereum multisig, timelock, proxy admin classified by type. MUSD/MEZO NTT Manager contracts classified as other/unknown. Token contracts classified as token/unknown.

D8: All addresses in admin_addresses[] trace to the fetched contracts-reference page. Audit-era contract file names (VotingEscrow, Voter, etc.) are NOT included as admin_addresses[] entries because no deployed addresses were discoverable — they are listed in unknowns[] per D8 requirement.

rationale.verdict: Discovery incomplete: the official contracts page and Halborn audit were successfully fetched, yielding 4 Mezo-chain pool contracts, bridged token addresses, NTT bridge addresses, and pre-mainnet Ethereum admin contracts. However, the core Mezo Earn governance contracts (VotingEscrow, Voter, all gauge and splitter deployments, MUSD Savings Rate vault) have no published deployed addresses in the official docs and the Mezo chain (chainId 31611) falls outside the DeFiPunkd-supported chainId set, blocking on-chain reads. grade=unknown because the primary Earn contract addresses cannot be confirmed from fetched sources.

evidence.shows: Protocol website entry point for Mezo Earn locking UI; confirms mezo.org as the canonical domain and that Mezo Earn is a live product

Official Mezo deployed contracts page listing PoolFactory (0x83FE469C636C4081b87bA5b3Ae9991c6Ed104248), MUSD/BTC Pool (0x52e604c44417233b6CcEDDDc0d640A405Caacefb), MUSD/mUSDC Pool (0xEd812AEc0Fecc8fD882Ac3eccC43f3aA80A6c356), MUSD/mUSDT Pool (0x10906a9E9215939561597b4C8e4b98F93c02031A) on Mezo chain; MUSD and MEZO token/NTT bridge addresses across Mezo, Ethereum, Base, BSC; pre-mainnet Ethereum contracts including multisig (0x98D8899c3030741925BE630C710A98B57F397C7a) and timelock (0x82f08041f1Bc1aa399320743F33f75CcA482b25a); Portal contracts on Ethereum. No Mezo Earn core contract (VotingEscrow/Voter/Gauge/Splitter) addresses listed.

Mezo Earn overview: dual-token ve system (veBTC NFT + veMEZO NFT), gauge voting mechanism, 7-day epochs, yield from swap fees/MUSD lending/bridging fees, PoolFactory and gauge contracts described as core components. Confirms Gauges are smart contracts on the Mezo chain.

Official audits page listing: Halborn Mezo Earn Audit (2026-01-08) and Thesis Defense Mezo Earn Audit (2026-01-30); also MUSD audit by Cantina (2025-04-15), mezod audits by Halborn (2024, 2025), bridge audits by Thesis Defense/Halborn/OtterSec, and Passport audits by Quantstamp/Thesis Defense

Halborn Mezo Earn security assessment (Dec 16 2025 - Jan 8 2026) of repository tigris-token-launch at commit 2ed567e; 26 contracts in scope including VotingEscrow, Voter, BoostVoter, ValidatorsVoter, NonStakingVoter, ThirdPartyVoter, MEZOChainSplitter, MEZOEcosystemSplitter, Splitter, MEZOMinter, gauge contracts (Gauge, NoFeesGauge, NonStakingGauge, PoolGauge, StakingGauge, VaultGauge), vault contracts (IdleStrategy, MUSDSavingsRate), ve/ module contracts. 100% of 16 findings addressed. No deployed addresses listed in scope section.

Cantina bug bounty page confirming Mezo Earn components (veBTC/veMEZO locking, voting, pools, vaults) as in-scope; auditors listed as Quantstamp, Halborn, Cantina, OtterSec, and Thesis Defense; confirms Mezo is built by Thesis (creators of tBTC)

protocol_metadata.about: Mezo Earn is the governance-incentive and yield distribution system of the Mezo network, a Bitcoin-native EVM-compatible appchain built by Thesis. Users lock BTC to receive veBTC NFTs and lock MEZO tokens to receive veMEZO NFTs; veBTC provides base voting power (1x) that can be boosted up to 5x by pairing with veMEZO. Participants vote on gauge contracts each 7-day epoch to direct MEZO emissions and fee revenue (from DEX swap fees, MUSD lending interest, and bridging/chain fees) to liquidity pools, validators, vaults, and ecosystem programs. The matching market allows BTC holders to post incentives on their per-position veBTC gauge to attract veMEZO boost from MEZO holders, turning boost into a tradable service.
